Both responses report the corrected figures accurately: $88,200 approved, $31,800 rolling over, the right Round 3 dates, the 31 October feedback deadline, and the 30 November acquittal cutoff. Both stay under 120 words. Response B also includes the conflict of interest, where Jarrah Wilson left the call for the Saltwater item. That is a governance point a manager may want to know, and Response A omits it. Response B's note that Saltwater was "corrected from $45,000" is useful because the manager may have seen the original figure elsewhere. Response A's extra framing adds little beyond what B already covers. Neither response has a factual error, so B is slightly better on the points the reader needs.

Verdict: B
